task_description: Create the WorldNest Online MVP - a cozy pixel-art MMO life simulation with pnpm monorepo architecture, ECS game engine, Phaser 3 rendering, procedural world generation with chunk streaming, player movement, Supabase auth and realtime multiplayer sync, and comprehensive documentation.

verification.summary: All 5 packages build successfully via turbo. 24 unit tests pass across 3 test files (ECS: 12, movement: 7, chunk-generator: 5). Docker multi-stage build produces standalone Next.js image. Tests exercise real game logic - ECS CRUD with component mutation, movement with deltaTime, deterministic chunk generation.
